properties.name: Hattusa — Hittite Capital
properties.description: Capital of the Hittite Empire with the famous Lion Gate. Archives here preserved the Kumarbi cycle and Illuyanka myths.

properties.name: Yazılıkaya Rock Sanctuary
properties.description: Open-air rock sanctuary near Hattusa with 90 carved reliefs of gods in procession. Chamber B may be an astronomical calendar.

properties.name: Cappadocia Underground Cities
properties.description: Ancient underground cities carved into volcanic tuff, extending up to 85m deep. Used as refuges and sacred spaces for millennia.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, tourist destination
